description: This file defines the JSON schema for the MaintenanceManager plugin API, including various methods, events, and data structures used to control and monitor maintenance activities on set-top devices. It specifies method signatures, parameters, result structures, and event notifications related to maintenance status and control.

methods.name: getMaintenanceActivityStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current maintenance status details including status string, last completion time, and reboot required flag.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduled start time for maintenance.

methods.name: setMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Sets the maintenance mode and software upgrade opt-out mode, with detailed explanation of each mode.

methods.name: startMaintenance
methods.description: Initiates maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: stopMaintenance
methods.description: Stops ongoing maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: getMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current maintenance mode and opt-out settings.
